source_text: Suppose that <MATH_0001> is a category. A functor <MATH_0002> from <MATH_0003> to <MATH_0004> is a mathematical object (i.e., it is a set not a class or a formula of set theory, see Sets, Section <REF_0001>) even though the category of sets is <OPENQUOTE_0001>big<CLOSEQUOTE_0001>. Namely, the range of <MATH_0005> on objects will be a set <MATH_0006> and then we may think of <MATH_0007> as a functor between <MATH_0008> and the full subcategory of the category of sets whose objects are elements of <MATH_0009>.
